claims.claim: Receiving the enhanced rate of the PIP mobility component automatically qualifies someone for a Blue Badge.
claims.quote: you receive a Personal Independence Payment ( PIP ) because you can’t walk more than 50 metres (a score of 8 points or more under the ‘moving around’ activity of the mobility component)
claims.note: The source gives specific PIP mobility activity-score routes but does not say the enhanced mobility rate alone automatically qualifies.

claims.claim: Receiving the highest mobility rate of DLA automatically qualifies someone for a Blue Badge.
claims.quote: you receive the higher rate of the mobility component of the Disability Living Allowance ( DLA )
claims.note: The source lists the higher rate of the DLA mobility component as an automatic qualification.

claims.claim: Certain awards under the Armed Forces and Reserve Forces Compensation Scheme automatically qualify someone for a Blue Badge.
claims.quote: you have received a lump sum benefit within tariff levels 1 to 8 of the Armed Forces and Reserve Forces (Compensation) Scheme and have been certified as having a permanent and substantial disability that causes inability to walk or very considerable difficulty in walking
claims.note: The source specifies tariff levels 1 to 8 and the associated disability certification.

claims.claim: Someone applying on non-automatic criteria must provide evidence of difficulty walking.
claims.quote: If you cannot walk or find walking difficult, you will also be asked questions around how your condition affects your walking.
claims.note: The source asks applicants with walking difficulty to give details of its effect on walking and offers supporting documents.
